_note: RapidAPI providers, each VERIFIED against a live call on 2026-08-22. One account-wide key (RAPIDAPI_KEY) but subscriptions are PER-API: an unsubscribed call returns 403 'You are not subscribed to this API', not 401, so a valid key looks broken unless you read the body.

maps-data.use: business discovery — the core of the outreach database
maps-data._locality_note: THE LOCALITY MUST BE IN THE QUERY, not just the country param. 'plumber' + country=ca returns NOTHING; 'plumber in Toronto' + country=ca returns results. The country code alone does not geo-fence the search, so a scrape driven only by country codes silently produces empty pages and looks like a quota problem.
maps-data.rate_limit: 2 req/sec observed; 20 results max per request

facebook-scraper3.use: Meta Ad Library — competitor creative and spend intelligence

twitter-api45.use: X/Twitter profile, community and timeline data

instagram-scraper-stable-api._note: Returned HTTP 200 with body {"error":"Please try again later. You wont be charged for this request."} — the provider's own soft-fail. Treat a 200 as success ONLY after checking for an `error` key; a naive status-code check would count these as real results.

linkedin-data-api.status: DEAD — do not build on this
linkedin-data-api._note: Returns 200 with {"success":false,"message":"This service is no longer available at this location."} The subscription is still active and still billable while returning nothing. Unsubscribe, and note that HTTP 200 means nothing here either.

reddit34.status: subscribed, returned no data on test
reddit34._note: 200 with {"success":false,"data":"data not found"}. Another case where the status code says nothing — check `success`.

instagram-scraper-api-stories-reels._note: 400 'Missing required parameters' using the provider's OWN documented example (?Userinfo=<handle>). Needs the real parameter list from the RapidAPI console before anything is built on it.

_purpose._business_note: ONE provider builds the outreach database. Everything else below is social/content intelligence — a different product surface. Nine subscriptions bill monthly; only maps-data moves rows into `businesses`.
